name: 飞雷神触发
description: 带有飞雷神标记的单位成为指向型技能目标时，水门可选择是否触发；触发后随机传送到对应目标身旁并释放螺旋丸，随后移除被触发单位的标记。
skillCode: var minato = context.rulePiece; if (!minato || minato.currentHp <= 0) return { success: false, message: '' }; var source = context.sourcePiece; var marked = context.targetPiece; if (!source || !marked || marked.currentHp <= 0 || context.skillId === 'minato-spiral-barrage') return { success: false, message: '' }; var mark = marked.statusTags && marked.statusTags.find(function(tag) { return tag.type === 'flying-raijin-mark' && tag.sourceId === minato.instanceId && (tag.stacks || 1) > 0; }); if (!mark) return { success: false, message: '' }; var target = null; if (marked.ownerPlayerId === minato.ownerPlayerId) { if (source.ownerPlayerId !== minato.ownerPlayerId && source.currentHp > 0) target = source; } else { target = marked; } if (!target || target.currentHp <= 0) return { success: false, message: '' }; var reserved = Array.isArray(context.reservedCells) ? context.reservedCells : []; var reservedAt = function(x, y) { return reserved.some(function(cell) { return cell && cell.x === x && cell.y === y; }); }; var offsets = [[1,0],[-1,0],[0,1],[0,-1]]; var landings = offsets.map(function(offset) { return { x: target.x + offset[0], y: target.y + offset[1] }; }).filter(function(cell) { var tile = battle.map.tiles.find(function(item) { return item.x === cell.x && item.y === cell.y; }); if (!tile || !tile.props || !tile.props.walkable || reservedAt(cell.x, cell.y)) return false; return !battle.pieces.some(function(piece) { return piece.currentHp > 0 && piece.x === cell.x && piece.y === cell.y; }); }); if (!landings.length) return { success: false, message: '' }; if (context.selectedOption === undefined) return { needsOptionSelection: true, title: minato.name + '是否触发飞雷神？', options: [{ label: '触发飞雷神，传送并释放螺旋丸', value: 'yes' }, { label: '不触发', value: 'no' }], playerId: minato.ownerPlayerId, canCancel: true, cancelValue: 'no' }; if (context.selectedOption !== 'yes') return { success: false, message: '' }; var landing = landings[Math.floor(Math.random() * landings.length)]; minato.x = landing.x; minato.y = landing.y; var result = dealDamage(minato, target, minato.attack, 'physical', battle, 'minato-rasengan'); minato.attack += 1; if (!target.statusTags) target.statusTags = []; var targetMark = target.statusTags.find(function(tag) { return tag.type === 'flying-raijin-mark' && tag.sourceId === minato.instanceId; }); if (targetMark) { targetMark.stacks = (targetMark.stacks || 1) + 1; targetMark.currentDuration = -1; } else { target.statusTags.push({ id: 'flying-raijin-mark-' + minato.instanceId + '-' + target.instanceId + '-' + Date.now(), type: 'flying-raijin-mark', name: '飞雷神', visible: true, currentDuration: -1, currentUses: -1, intensity: 1, stacks: 1, sourceId: minato.instanceId }); } marked.statusTags = (marked.statusTags || []).filter(function(tag) { return !(tag.type === 'flying-raijin-mark' && tag.sourceId === minato.instanceId); }); return { success: true, message: minato.name + '触发飞雷神，传送至' + target.name + '身旁释放螺旋丸，造成' + result.damage + '点伤害并攻击力+1' };
